title: 秋華賞の後に・アイツのいる場所へ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That race felt… amazing! Was that great or what, Teach?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon was so cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she'll run against Narita Brian someday. Now that would be a race to watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The audience's excitement mounts over a potential battle of the greats.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Here we have Hishi Amazon, a racer who's been turning heads with her strong performance in the Tiara tour. Congrats on your fantastic Shuka Sho run!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks a lot! It was really satisfying to get out there and go one-on-one with such strong opponents!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now, I finally feel ready!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: …Ready? Could you please elaborate?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nothing gets me fired up like a good rival—and there's someone in the Twinkle Series that I just have to face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The room is stirred into a frenzy just by her name alone. After all, she's a beast of a runner who's currently taking the world by storm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …Thing is, I realized last year that I wasn't good enough yet to put up a decent fight.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So I made the decision to take on the Tiara tour and make myself even better!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And now, I've blasted through the Tiara tour and finally reached a level I can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm ready, it's time to declare total war on Narita Brian and give her a run for her money!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Oh! Does this mean your next race will be—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You betcha! It's gonna be the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Sounds like we're in for the dramatic clash everyone's been waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: While we've got the camera rolling, is there anything you want to tell Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon looks directly at the camera, her eyes absolutely burning with competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Brian. I've been tryin' to catch up to you all this time, itching to go one-on-one at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm the Hishi Amazon, and I'm gonna give you everything I've got, so just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You got that, Teach?! Get ready for some high-octane power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Word of her bold declaration spreads like wildfire from news outlet to news outlet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh. The Arima Kinen, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stage is set. The one-on-one we've been preparing for is just around the corner. And now, we're staring down the homestretch.
